items.label: 俄共（布）
items.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: this existing adviser faction icon. Replace the composition with ONLY a traditional crossed hammer and curved sickle. REMOVE the star completely, remove every background shape and ornament. No star, no circle, no flag, no wreath, no backing, no frame. A single recognizable hammer-and-sickle silhouette, luminous golden yellow metal with broad pale ivory-gold lit faces and shallow amber shadow cuts. Keep the metal engraving subtle and historical strategy-game style, not a cute cartoon or glossy jewelry. This must read clearly as a TINY 20x20 text icon against a dark charcoal adviser list: large thick simple shapes, high overall brightness rather than just bright edges, near-black only for thin internal separations. Fill 84% of the square with the complete symbol, 8% transparent margin around it. Transparent background. No text. Return a single complete finished transparent icon.

items.label: 社革党
items.prompt: Edit this complete historical strategy-game adviser faction icon. Preserve its recognizable subject, arrangement and irregular frameless silhouette. This is a brightness and palette revision for a TINY 20x20 pixel in-game text icon on a dark charcoal adviser list. CRITICAL: at least 75% of the visible opaque artwork must be BRIGHT GOLDEN YELLOW or PALE IVORY GOLD, with a high midtone brightness across whole shapes, not just shiny edge highlights. Large filled golden shapes should remain clear when reduced to 20 pixels. Replace dark red, dark blue, grey steel, black iron and dark bronze body areas with luminous warm satin gold. Use shallow amber-gold shadow planes only; reserve near-black for very thin engraved separations, never broad areas. Keep colored accents under 10% of the visual mass. Fine restrained wear, not heavy grime; matte engraved metal game art, not cute cartoon, glossy jewelry or deep 3D relief. No circular backing, no new border, no wreath, no extra shapes, no letters, no text. Keep all transparency and an 8% transparent margin. Return one complete finished transparent icon. The sun, twelve rays and leaves all become bright yellow gold; keep only tiny green leaf accents. Sun and rays remain distinct by gold tone and narrow engraved cuts.
